asks.q: How many national championships does Florida have?
asks.answer: Florida won the 2008 BCS National Championship, beating Oklahoma 24-14 on Jan. 8, 2009, in Miami. Tim Tebow was the quarterback and Urban Meyer the head coach. It is Florida's third and most recent football national title. [1]
